evidence_spans: A wideband response takes from minutes to tens of minutes with a periodic full-wave solver, while the proposed model evaluates it in a few tens of milliseconds on the same workstation, roughly three orders of magnitude faster.

CLM-PHOT-0137.statement: The proposed analytical Jacobi-Galerkin model evaluates a wideband response in a few tens of milliseconds on the workstation, which is roughly three orders of magnitude faster than a periodic full-wave solver.

extra_quotes: This paper presents, to the author’s knowledge, the first analytical model, restricted to elliptical meta-atoms on a uniform lattice.
The Galerkin method is applied directly to the geometry of the patches, without spatial meshing.
An affine transformation maps any rotated ellipse onto the unit disk, so that a single formulation covers every configuration.
As a reference, a full-wave periodic Method of Moments (MoM) solver was implemented for planar metallic patches on a grounded dielectric slab.
